# nxos_segment_routing (Data Source)

This data source can read the Segment Routing configuration on NX-OS devices, including SRGB label blocks, MPLS connected prefix SID mappings, SRv6 locators and Segment Routing Traffic Engineering (SR-TE) policies, on-demand colors, segment lists, affinities and PCC settings.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `affinity_colors` (Attributes Map) List of affinity colors and their bit position in the affinity bit map.
  - Map key: `name` - User defined named of the affinity Color Affinity Name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--affinity_colors))
- `domains` (Attributes Map) List of Segment Routing domains.
  - Map key: `name` - The name of the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `global_blocks` (Attributes Map) List of Segment Routing Global Block configurations.
  - Map key: `type` - SRGB type.
  - Key choices: `mpls`, `ipv6` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_blocks))
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `instance_control` (String) The control state.
- `liveness_detection_bfd_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `liveness_detection_interval` (Number) Interval for liveness detection.
- `liveness_detection_multiplier` (Number) Multiplier for liveness detection.
- `liveness_detection_oam_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `on_demand_colors` (Attributes Map) List of on-demand colors.
  - Map key: `color` - Segment Routing TE Color Value.
  - Key range: `0`-`4294967295` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_colors))
- `pcc_source_address` (String) Local IP address to use as the source address for PCEP connections.
- `pces` (Attributes Map) List of PCEs to which a PCEP connection may be created.
  - Map key: `address` - SRTE PCE IP Address Value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pces))
- `policies` (Attributes Map) List of SR-TE policies.
  - Map key: `name` - Segment Routing TE Policy Name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))
- `segment_lists` (Attributes Map) List of explicit segment lists.
  - Map key: `name` - SRTE Explicit Segment List Name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segment_lists))
- `srgb_allocation_retry_interval` (Number) SRGB allocation retry interval.
- `srgb_cleanup_interval` (Number) SRGB cleanup interval.
- `srv6_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `srv6_encapsulation_source_address` (String) IPv6 address.
- `srv6_encapsulation_source_interface` (String) Interface, most likely a loopback.
- `srv6_locators` (Attributes Map) List of SRv6 locators.
  - Map key: `name` - Locator name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--srv6_locators))
- `traffic_engineering_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `traffic_engineering_encapsulations` (Attributes Map) List of SR-TE encapsulations.
  - Map key: `type` - SRTE Encapsulation Type.
  - Key choices: `mpls` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--traffic_engineering_encapsulations))
- `traffic_engineering_interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of SR-TE interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Interface ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--traffic_engineering_interfaces))
- `traffic_engineering_srv6_locators` (Attributes Map) List of SRv6 Traffic Engineering locators.
  - Map key: `name` - Locator name for SRv6 Traffic Engineering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--traffic_engineering_srv6_locators))

<a id="nestedatt--on_demand_colors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_demand_colors`

Read-Only:

- `candidate_paths` (Attributes Map) List of candidate path preferences.
  - Map key: `preference` - Preference Value of the Candidate path. Higher preference value is preferred.
  - Key range: `0`-`4294967295` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_colors--candidate_paths))
- `liveness_detection_bfd_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `liveness_detection_index_limit` (Number) Sid index limit for liveness detection.
- `liveness_detection_oam_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `liveness_detection_shutdown` (Boolean) Shut liveness detection.
- `lockdown` (Boolean) lockdown keyword is used to disable re-optimization of the path preferences for policies using this color template.
- `metric_type` (String) Segment Routing TE Metric.
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the Segment Routing TE Policies using this color template.

<a id="nestedatt--on_demand_colors--candidate_paths"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_demand_colors.candidate_paths`

Read-Only:

- `dataplane` (String) Specifies if this candidate paths is encoded with MPLS SIDs or SRv6 SIDs.
- `disjoint_id` (Number) Association group Identifier.
- `disjoint_type` (String) Specifies the type of disjointness this path needs to be.
- `dynamic_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `dynamic_metric_type` (String) Candidate Path Metric Type.
- `dynamic_pcep_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `exclude_any_affinity_colors` (Attributes Map) Affinity colors for the exclude any affinity constraint.
  - Map key: `name` - Name of the affinity Color definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_colors--candidate_paths--exclude_any_affinity_colors))
- `explicit_segment_lists` (Attributes Map) List of explicit segment lists.
  - Map key: `name` - Explicit path name. Must be the name of an existing segment list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_colors--candidate_paths--explicit_segment_lists))
- `include_all_affinity_colors` (Attributes Map) Affinity colors for the include all affinity constraint.
  - Map key: `name` - Name of the affinity Color definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_colors--candidate_paths--include_all_affinity_colors))
- `include_any_affinity_colors` (Attributes Map) Affinity colors for the include any affinity constraint.
  - Map key: `name` - Name of the affinity Color definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_demand_colors--candidate_paths--include_any_affinity_colors))
- `protection_type` (String) Specifies if the candidate path must use protected or unprotected SIDs.
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the Candidate path preference.
